{{Top|leg|title=''Jenth''-class hypermatter core}}
The '''''Jenth''-class hypermatter core''' was a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|reactor]] model.

==History==
During a discussion on the [[Malevolence/Legends|mysterious vessel]] behind a dozen attacks on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] naval task forces in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was postulated by [[Umak Leth]] that a [[Jenth/Legends|''Jenth''-class hypermatter core]] could power a vessel of tremendous size to allow it to engage and defeat numerous vessels such as the ones destroyed in the attacks.
